test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Given below are two statements and two conclusions. Take the statements to be true even if they are at variance with commonly known facts, and decide whether the conclusion(s) follow(s) the given statements.

**Statements:**

All eyes are noses.

Some noses are lips.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some noses are eyes.

II. All lips are noses.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statements:

All eyes are noses.

Some noses are lips.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a26c519d43281c87683f48ebfb09d114291182e4d740389205a77e77dc2f2c0e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some noses are eyes - True (Because, All eyes are noses, it also gives Some noses are eyes).

II. All lips are noses - False (Because, Some noses are lips, so All lips are noses can be possible only).

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
